title: Western Subanon language
description: Austronesian language spoken on the Philippines
extract: Western Subanon is an Austronesian language belonging Subanen branch of the Greater Central Philippine subgroup. It is spoken by c. 300,000 people in the southwestern part of the Zamboanga Peninsula region of Mindanao.
